No. The rules file makes `is.waiwai.dictation` permanent. A new identifier makes macOS treat OpenRamble as a different app, so anyone who already granted Accessibility would have to re-grant it. Sparkle also requires the same bundle identifier to install an update, so existing installs couldn't update into the renamed app.

Keep the identifier and rename what users see: the product name, the display name, and the menu and window text. The launch can say OpenRamble while the identifier stays `is.waiwai.dictation`.

If you still want the identifier changed, that overrides a rule you wrote. We'd need to update the rule first and plan how existing users re-grant permission. I haven't read the repo, so I'd confirm the list of name locations before editing.
